verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents the AP workflow described in the story: dragging in a vendor invoice, auto-matching to PO, GL coding, routing for approval, and paying the vendor (ramp-docs-2), with dynamic parallel approval routing across departments (ramp-docs-16) and API/CLI support to create approved bills, attach documents, choose a payment method, and pay vendors end-to-end (ramp-docs-23, ramp-supp-cli-agent-mode). AI agents are also documented as handling auto-coding, approval routing, and payment (ramp-docs-17, ramp-supp-ramp-agents-product), and community feedback corroborates smooth expense/approval flows in Ramp generally (ramp-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically of the bill-upload-to-vendor-payment flow (vs. general card/expense approval), and more detail on multi-step/multi-approver escalation edge cases beyond marketing copy.
